sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Since 2015, in response to growing demand and to improve living conditions on the campus of Cheikh Anta Diop University, the Senegalese state has relied on AMSA Realty SA (the real-estate arm of the insurer AMSA) to develop around ten residences and house an additional 10,000 students in the UCAD and Claudel sectors. From the outset, project management was entrusted to the REDMAN group and its local agency, while architectural design was assigned to HARDEL LE BIHAN ARCHITECTES, in collaboration with Dakar-based ALUN BE and landscape studio Niez Studio.
